Tom yum noodles are `a hot and sour Thai dish featuring noodles flavored with lemongrass, lime, and chili` . Popular instant options include [Mama Creamy Shrimp Tom Yum Noodles](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/product/mama-oriental-style-instant-noodles-shrimp-creamy-tom-yum-flavour-90g) (~£0.95) and [Koka Tom Yum Noodles](https://www.tesco.com/shop/en-GB/products/261626494?srsltid=AfmBOopuSI1ZB7LyuCTM9pV_ggRlIYQH02mZ-XGNv_MxEyBl9wqb-pW_) (~£0.40). You can also make them fresh as a rich soup or a dry-style tossed noodle dish.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6372947982364115769,catalogid:14326405103345803947,gpcid:17316359456149038886,mid:576462746182337139&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5923323983172272493,catalogid:14385253911353900385,gpcid:5857385857229104619,mid:576462832660465203&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DWO55vAAFL_/?hl=en)[[5]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/tom-yum-soup)

Instant vs. Homemade Styles

- **Instant:** Quick packs like Mama or Koka ready in 3 minutes with hot water.
- **Soup:** Rice or egg noodles in a broth of galangal, lemongrass, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili paste.
- **Dry:** Noodles tossed directly in lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and chili flakes, served without a heavy broth.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eJPVWaBCDt0&t=9) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eJPVWaBCDt0&t=9)
